claims.claim: Bedrock credential: role ARN beats profile beats the default chain
Vertex credential: service account key file, else Application Default Credentials
Azure credential: client secret beats managed identity client ID beats the default chain; an empty client ID selects nothing
Credential errors are prefixed bedrock credentials, vertex credentials and azure credentials
WithPlatformRegion, WithPlatformProject, WithPlatformEndpoint; Bedrock/Vertex endpoint replaces the base URL; Azure defers to the openai factory
Bedrock model names are mapped through the Bedrock model mapping; Vertex base URL differs by provider type
Default chains: AWS (IRSA, instance profile, env), GCP ADC, Azure (managed identity, CLI)
